newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo builders expect $600 mln from Russia works.
newsitem.headline: Yugo builders expect $600 mln from Russia works.

text.p: Yugoslav construction firms expect to get around $600 million in business from investment projects in Russia in 1997, Belgrade newspapers reported on Monday.

"With construction works in Russia presently worth around $40-50 million per month, their total value in 1997 is expected to reach $600 million," Yugoslav construction industry official Radomir Teofilovic was quoted by daily Borba as saying.

Teofilovic, who heads a Committee of Yugoslav firms active in the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), said more than 120 Yugoslav firms were working on 900 construction projects in Russia and other CIS states.

A total of some 12,000 Yugoslav workers are employed in Russia, or half the number engaged in 1995 when Russia experienced a real investment boom, but more than twice as many as in 1993, Teofilovic said. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
